geometry.note: Drawn as a generic point, not as a hall: this is a single undifferentiated position for the whole underground complex, not this hall's own surveyed footprint (none is sourced; checked 2026-09-18), and a hall feature would imply a footprint polygon that this record does not have.

method: Midpoint (6142 m from the Assergi portal) of the LNGS laboratory access zone, itself walked along the OSM tunnel line from the official emergency-plan chainage of the laboratory's entrance and exit doors (see that record's method). This is the best-sourced position for the LNGS underground complex as a whole; no source consulted (checked 2026-09-18) distinguishes which position within the roughly 700 m access zone this hall occupies, or the order of Halls A, B and C along it, so all three hall records are drawn at this same point and accuracy is widened to 400 m (roughly the zone's own half-span) to say so.
name: LNGS Hall A (undifferentiated position within the underground complex)
notes: Duplicate coordinates with Hall B and Hall C are intentional: the three halls are known to lie within the same sourced ~700 m zone, but nothing consulted orders them along it. A coarse sourced position is more informative than leaving the halls off the map.

summary.plain: An approximate marker for LNGS Hall A, placed at the centre of the sourced ~700-metre zone that the three main halls occupy; their individual order along it is not sourced.
